findings.title: README still documents `--output`, which this change renames to `--out`
findings.description: README.md line 7 says "Run `reviso-sync --output <path>` to write the merged manifest to a file". The change renames the option to `out` and reads `values.out`; `--output` is now an unknown flag. The README sentence is false as of this change. Update it to `--out <path>`.
